task_definition.input_notes: Source tokenization and selected visible structure are explicitly given. No sentence type, summary, entity annotations, EDU boundaries, relation labels or signal annotations are public. No claim of raw end-to-end tokenization. Source texts can be excerpts.
task_definition.environment_precedence: GUM-specific rules override RST-DT guidance; eRST formalism extends RST. No ANNIS lookup of current evaluation labels. Full theory papers provided as references; their combined page count is not a necessary-context claim.
